Definition: from G3753 and G302; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as:--as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.
BiblicalUsage: hótan is the word for whenever, as soon as. In Matthew 5:11, the text says "when [men] shall revile you."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hótan means whenever, as soon as, and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
